title: Controversial Remark Sparks Concern Over Mumbai Muharram Incident
summary: A controversial remark made by Premji, accused of throwing toxic capsules during a Mumbai Muharram procession, has raised questions about his mental state and potential motives. The incident has sparked concerns about the safety of participants in such events and the need for better support systems for individuals struggling with mental health issues.
summary_points: Premji's remark suggests he may have turned away from his community after feeling ignored.
